newsitem.title: CHINA: Red chip Guangnan buys assets from parent.
newsitem.headline: Red chip Guangnan buys assets from parent.

text.p: Red chip Guangnan Holdings will acquire assets valued at HK$288 million from its parent company, Guangdong Development (Holdings) Ltd, in exchange for new shares and a cash payment, the company said on Thursday.

Guangnan would acquire a 40 percent stake in each of two Sino-foreign joint ventures and the entire issued capital of Hinloon International Ltd with the issue of 21.62 million new shares, issued at HK$11.47 a share, and a cash payment of HK$40.02 million, a company statement said.
As a result, Guangdong Development's stake in Guangnan would be raised to 59.7 percent from 58.6 percent, it said.
The parent company was guaranteeing total net profit of not less than HK$34 million for the three companies for each of the coming three years ending December 31, 1999, the statement said.
This put the sale on a base price earning ratio of 8.47 times, it said.
The vendor also guaranteed the combined net tangible asset value of three acquisitions would not be less than 340 million yuan, the statement said.

The joint ventures and Hinloon are primarily engaged in the processing and sale of corn starch, refined corn oil, corn gluten meal, corn fibre feed and other related processed corn foodstuffs and animal feed products.
The majority of the companies' production were exported, it said.
